rationale: Bare set -e is the only errfail form in any loop action body (3 sites, fleet-loop-improve.yaml incl. its commit state); the combined form has zero loop-action-body precedent (standalone .sh scripts only). Engine contract (plain bash -c, non-zero exit routes to on_error) makes both forms functionally identical for pipeline-free bodies.
rule: Loop action bodies use bare set -e for errfail, never set -euo pipefail
alternatives_rejected: set -euo pipefail (Option A): inert-safe here but first-of-its-kind action-body form, 0 of 16 corpus set- headers
